attempts.text:
Shivapuri shelter is the only valid drop-off point because Kispang temple is not designated, so every trip has to end there. The car carries 4 people at a time.

**Trips**

| Trip | Route | People rescued | Driving time |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Shelter → Kalika village → Shelter | 4 elderly | 14 min |
| 2 | Shelter → Trishuli farm → Shelter | 4 elderly | 78 min |
| 3 | Shelter → Trishuli farm → Shelter | 3 elderly | 78 min |

**Why this is the lowest cost**
- **Rescue or defer:** Deferring costs 50 per elderly person. Even the most expensive trip per person, the last Trishuli run, costs 78 minutes against 150 in penalties for its 3 people. Rescuing everyone is therefore cheaper.
- **Trishuli route:** The direct road takes 39 minutes each way, while going via Kispang temple takes 54 (45 + 9), so the direct road is best.
- **Number of trips:** Trishuli's 7 people need at least 2 trips. Kalika can only be reached through the shelter, so it needs its own trip, and combining it with a Trishuli run wouldn't save any driving.

<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter kalika-village
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-village shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter trishuli-farm
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 trishuli-farm shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter trishuli-farm
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 trishuli-farm shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
</plan>

All 11 people are rescued, with no one deferred, so the total cost is 170 minutes of driving.

COST: 170
